info.title: Rotavise API
info.description: Crop rotation planning for Moroccan farms from NASA data. Results are decision aids built on rules that no agronomist has reviewed yet; every result says which rules and data it used. Reason codes, statuses and terms are explained in plain language by GET /api/v1/glossary. Routes marked x-requires exist only when those server settings are on. The sign-in endpoints under /api/auth/ belong to the account library and are not described here; an internal weather route and the development test jobs are also left out.

get.summary: Suggested field outlines in a zoom-14 tile
get.description: Precomputed FTW 2025 suggestions, shared reference data. Whole polygons whose bounding boxes intersect a zoom-14 Web Mercator tile. No inference or upstream requests. 60 reads per owner per minute, plus 120 requests per IP per minute. Empty areas return an empty collection. Farmer must check outlines. Confidence is a rescaled 500 m cell score, not geometric accuracy. See attribution and limitations in every success response.

401.description: Not signed in, or the session or token is no longer valid.

429.description: A usage limit was reached; see the Retry-After header.

post.summary: Find a suggested outline containing a point
post.description: Strict interior lookup in the active imported dataset. Where suggestions overlap, returns the smallest area, then source id. No persisted taps and no automatic fallback. 20 requests per owner per hour, plus 120 requests per IP per minute. Cookie requests require a trusted Origin. No suggestion is an honest gap, not a claim that the land is not agricultural.

Says the API process is running. It checks nothing else.
Checks the queue and the databases the API depends on.

Every reason code, status, evidence class, score, error code and satellite term the API returns, in English (en), French (fr), Standard Arabic (ar) or Moroccan Arabic / Darija (ary). Arabic and Darija read right to left. Text is model-written and not yet reviewed by a person; the provenance field says so.

get.summary: Crop detail and listed health issues from an immutable catalog version
get.description: Includes BG-5 issues with issue_id, original catalog kinds, language-labelled names and evidence. Missing metadata is null or empty with explicit gaps. Primary names have no assumed language. Rules retain their exact scope, conditions, units and verification. Sourced reference facts without recorded verification return null verification. Releases with research also include all 12 benefit effects, original findings/records, nullable recorded confidence, cited income facts, no_data for absent kinds, and general role explanations in four languages (not crop-specific role assignments). Older release response bytes are unchanged. Only referenced catalog sources are included; role citations have their own URLs. Responses are limited to 2 MiB; an oversized response returns 503 without truncation. Public cache: max-age=3600, immutable; ETag hashes the response bytes. If-None-Match supports weak tags, lists and *; 304 has no body. Errors use no-store.
